reuse.why: The tree has no shared selection of month-wide categories, so there was nothing to reuse, but the change does not introduce one either and extends each inline query.

duplication.why: The #fixed rule (join on notes plus NOT LIKE filter) is pasted into five SQL queries and re-expressed once more in JS for copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: The rule sits in budget/actions.ts next to the other exclusions, though split between SQL WHERE clauses and an in-memory check.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, getBudgetData and a test are touched.

maintainability.why: Six independent copies of the rule, two of them in different forms (substring LIKE vs includes), must be kept in step by hand; an extraction of the shared exclusion would have been the natural move.

disguised_duplication.where: The five SQL copies in setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set12MonthAvg and set6MonthAvg are literal; copyPreviousMonth's group_notes?.includes('#fixed') is the same rule written openly in JS.

one_place.where: Rule is written separately in copyPreviousMonth (JS) and in the WHERE clause of each of the five other month-wide actions in budget/actions.ts.
